entities.summary: Austin Hunter Johnson is an American professional football defensive tackle for the Jacksonville Jaguars of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Penn State Nittany Lions, and was drafted by the Tennessee Titans in the second round of the 2016 NFL draft. Johnson has also played for the New York Giants, Los Angeles Chargers, and Buffalo Bills.
